verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a payments platform like SumUp, but the evidence documents no batch or bulk endpoint. Checkouts and refunds are shown as single-item operations. The ability to run simultaneous transactions on multiple Solo readers is device concurrency, not a bulk operation across many items, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
